import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from itertools import product
bases='TCAG'; aas='FFLLSSSSYY**CC*WLLLLPPPPHHQQRRRRIIIMTTTTNNKKSSRRVVVVAAAADDEEGGGG'
ct={a+b+c:aas[i] for i,(a,b,c) in enumerate(product(bases,repeat=3))}
def translate(s):
    o=''
    for i in range(0,len(s)-2,3):
        c=ct.get(s[i:i+3].upper(),'X')
        if c=='*': break
        o+=c
    return o
CANON="MAEPQPPSGGLTDEAALSCCSDADPSTKDFLLQQTMLRVKDPKKSLDFYTRVLGMTLIQKCDFPIMKFSLYFLAYEDKNDIPKEKDEKIAWALSRKATLELTHNWGTEDDETQSYHNGNSDPRGFGHIGIAVPDVYSACKRFEELGVKFVKKPDDGKMKGLAFIQDPDGYWIEILNPNKMATLM"
accs=['D13315','L07837','S83285','AB209801','AK293345','AK312662','BT019987','BT019988','BC001741','BC011365','BC015934','NM_006708']
fa=requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi",
  params={"db":"nuccore","id":",".join(accs),"rettype":"fasta","retmode":"text"},timeout=120).text
seqs={}
for b in fa.split('>'):
    if b.strip():
        h,*r=b.split('\n'); seqs[h.split()[0].split('.')[0]]=''.join(r).upper()
rows=[]
for a in accs:
    s=seqs[a]; best=''
    for i in range(len(s)-60):
        if s[i:i+3]=='ATG':
            p=translate(s[i:])
            if len(p)>150 and 'TLELTHN' in p and len(p)>len(best): best=p
    diffs=[f"{CANON[i]}{i+1}{best[i]}" for i in range(min(len(CANON),len(best))) if CANON[i]!=best[i]] if len(best)==184 else []
    rows.append(dict(accession=a, orf_aa=len(best), form='isoform 2 (del 105-119)' if len(best)==169 else 'canonical 184 aa',
                     variants=','.join(diffs) if diffs else '-'))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print("=== INSDC GLO1 cDNA survey (provenance table) ===")
print(df.to_string(index=False))
n169=(df.orf_aa==169).sum()
print(f"\n{n169} of {len(df)} independent GLO1 cDNAs encode the 169-aa form; all others encode 184 aa.")
print(f"E111A (rs4746) seen in {sum('E111A' in v for v in df.variants)} clones, inside the deleted segment.")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
ax=axes[0]
cols=['#E45756' if f.startswith('isoform') else '#4C78A8' for f in df.form]
ax.barh(range(len(df)), df.orf_aa, color=cols)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(df))); ax.set_yticklabels(df.accession,fontsize=8); ax.invert_yaxis()
ax.axvline(184,color='k',lw=0.7,ls=':')
ax.set_xlim(150,195); ax.set_xlabel('longest GLO1 ORF (aa)')
ax.set_title('a. 1 of 12 INSDC GLO1 cDNAs encodes 169 aa\n(AK293345 / FLJ51791, NEDO splice-variant project)',fontsize=10)

ax=axes[1]; ax.axis('off')
ax.set_title('b. mRNA junction of the 45 nt deletion',fontsize=10)
up="CTTGAGCTGACACACAAT"; blk="TGGGGCACTGAAGATGATGAGACCCAGAGTTACCACAATGGCAAT"; dn="TCAGACCCTCGAGG"
ax.text(0.01,0.78,"canonical  5'-"+up+"  "+blk+"  "+dn+"-3'",family='monospace',fontsize=7.0)
ax.text(0.01,0.60,"isoform 2  5'-"+up+"  "+" "*len(blk)+"  "+dn+"-3'",family='monospace',fontsize=7.0)
ax.text(0.01,0.40,"CDS 295-312      CDS 313-357 (deleted)        CDS 358-",family='monospace',fontsize=7.0)
ax.text(0.01,0.18,"4 nt direct repeat CAAT flanks the deleted block\n"
                  "(ends of CDS 312 and CDS 357), consistent with\n"
                  "reverse-transcriptase slippage; p(chance)~4e-3, suggestive only.\n"
                  "No GT-AG, GC-AG or AT-AC splice pair exists at any register.",fontsize=8.5)

ax=axes[2]
sp=pd.DataFrame([('E. coli GloA\n(135 aa, Ni)',18),('human GLO1\ncanonical',27),('human GLO1\nisoform 2',12)],columns=['x','v'])
ax.bar(sp.x,sp.v,color=['#9D755D','#4C78A8','#E45756'])
for i,v in enumerate(sp.v): ax.text(i,v+0.4,str(v),ha='center')
ax.set_ylabel('residues between metal ligand 2 and ligand 3')
ax.set_title('c. Connector length between the\n2nd and 3rd metal ligands',fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
